jobs.description:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The next era of enterprise technology will not be won by simply knowing the platform. It will be won by helping customers make the right architectural choices as AI reshapes how data, applications, experiences, security, and work come together.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Architecture & Innovation
to lead a multi-layered organization of Core Technical and Enterprise Architecture leaders and highly experienced talent across CBS.

This is not a traditional architecture leadership role.

We need a leader who can see around corners, create a point of view, mobilize teams quickly, and translate emerging technology into clear choices for customers and our field, someone who can move comfortably between an executive customer conversation, a deep architectural debate, a strategy session with Sales and Solutions leadership, and an executive update on what we are learning across the business.

You will lead teams responsible for helping customers understand how to govern AI responsibly, activate the full Salesforce platform, prepare data and architecture for production, and reimagine experiences as new technologies emerge.

Just as importantly, you will create leverage. The best work of the organization should not remain inside a single account or team. You will turn what we learn into strong points of view, architectural patterns, field guidance, and repeatable approaches that make the entire CBS organization better.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale an Exceptional Architecture Organization

Lead and develop a multi-layered organization of frontline leaders and senior architects across a diverse set of architecture and innovation disciplines
Create a high bar for technical excellence, customer impact, pace, accountability, and executive presence
Build an environment where teams are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment thoughtfully, and bring forward new ideas before they are asked
Develop strong leaders who can independently run their businesses while operating as one integrated architecture organization
Attract, grow, and retain exceptional architecture talent while creating clear opportunities for career development and succession

Create the Architectural Point of View

Establish clear, proactive perspectives on the architectural questions our customers are facing across AI, data, security, governance, integration, platform strategy, emerging technology, and digital experiences
Anticipate where customer architecture is heading and ensure CBS is prepared to lead those conversations, not react to them
Move quickly from signal to insight to action, without waiting for perfect information when the field needs direction
Translate complex technical shifts into simple frameworks, reference architectures, patterns, and recommendations that customers and account teams can act on
Ensure the organization consistently connects architectural decisions to business outcomes, platform strategy, and the customer's path to production

Lead the Most Important Customer Conversations

Serve as a trusted architecture executive for strategic customers navigating complex transformation decisions
Lead conversations that help CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and other technology leaders understand choices, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities
Elevate conversations beyond products and features to how the customer's technology landscape must evolve for an agentic enterprise
Create confidence when the answer is complex, multiple technologies are involved, or the path forward is not yet obvious
Step into critical opportunities and escalations with urgency, clarity, and strong executive judgment
Lead and participate in key customer on-sites, SICs, and workshops, as well as conferences (TDX, DF, etc.)

Make Customers Builder-Ready

Ensure architecture teams create the clarity required before hands-on building begins: business outcome, use case and scope, target architecture, data and grounding, actions and integrations, trust guardrails, dependencies, and path to production
Partner closely with Builder leadership so Builder teams enter engagements understanding the architecture, key decisions, dependencies, and definition of done
Maintain a clear distinction between architectural leadership and hands-on implementation while ensuring the two motions operate seamlessly together
Identify architectural blockers early and mobilize the right teams to resolve them before they slow execution
Help create repeatable patterns that move customers faster from strategy and experimentation to production

Be an Exceptional Cross-Functional Partner

Operate as a deeply trusted partner to Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, Product, Engineering, and other specialist organizations
Bring teams together around the customer problem rather than organizational boundaries
Create clear roles and handoffs while maintaining shared accountability for the customer outcome
Partner with peers generously. The goal is not for Architecture to own every technical conversation, but to make every team around it stronger
Surface patterns from the field to Product and Engineering, and help translate product direction back into actionable guidance for customer-facing teams

Amplify the Work of the Team

Make exceptional work visible and reusable across CBS and Salesforce
Identify the ideas, architectures, customer lessons, and innovations that should be elevated beyond an individual engagement
Turn field learning into executive-ready narratives, POVs, reusable assets, and scalable enablement
Create mechanisms for architects to share ideas, challenge one another, and continuously raise the technical bar
Give individual architects and leaders visibility for their work, and create opportunities for the team's strongest voices to influence customers, the field, and our product strategy

Communicate With Clarity and Influence

Maintain strong communication with senior leadership on customer signals, architectural trends, emerging risks, team priorities, and opportunities
Distill a complex portfolio of work into the few things executives need to understand and act on
Bring recommendations, not just updates. Surface issues early, frame tradeoffs clearly, and propose a path forward
Build trust through transparency, strong judgment, and consistent follow-through
Represent the organization with credibility at every level, from deeply technical teams to Salesforce executives and customer C-suites

What Success Looks Like

You will know this organization is succeeding when:

Customers seek us out for the broader technical vision, not simply for answers to product questions
Our architects shape decisions earlier, before architecture becomes a blocker to execution
Builders start ready, with clearer architecture, dependencies, guardrails, and success criteria
Our best thinking scales, rather than remaining trapped inside individual accounts
Executive leadership has clear visibility into what the organization is learning, where customers are struggling, and where Salesforce should lean in
The team moves with urgency, taking initiative and creating direction rather than waiting for requests
Our leaders and architects are recognized voices with customers, internally, and in the broader technical community
Sales, Solutions, Builders, Success, and Product view Architecture as one of their strongest partners

What We're Looking For

Transformational Leadership

Proven experience leading leaders and senior technical talent through change. You create clarity, raise standards, build followership, and translate strategy into action.

Architecture & Technology Depth

Deep understanding of enterprise architecture and modern technology landscapes, including cloud platforms, data, AI, integration, identity, security, governance, APIs, and modern application and experience architectures. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you must know how to lead experts and connect the pieces.

Executive Presence

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical topics with senior customer and internal executives. You can simplify without losing substance and are comfortable challenging assumptions when needed.

Customer and Business Acumen

You understand that architecture exists to enable a business outcome. You can connect technical choices to value, risk, speed, adoption, and long-term platform strategy.

Strong Point of View

You are intellectually curious and proactive. You develop perspectives on where technology and customer needs are heading and are comfortable putting a recommendation on the table.

Bias for Action

You operate with urgency. You identify what needs to happen, mobilize the right people, and move. You are comfortable making progress in ambiguity and adjusting as new information emerges.

Organizational Influence

You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across organizational boundaries. You can align strong leaders with different priorities around a common outcome without relying on hierarchy.

Executive Communication

You know how to manage a complex portfolio upward. You surface what matters, make risks visible early, amplify the work of your team, and consistently bring senior leaders clarity and recommendations.

Talent Leadership

You are passionate about developing leaders and creating an environment where exceptional technical talent can do the best work of their careers.

THE LEADERSHIP PROFILE

We are looking for an operator, architect, storyteller, and multiplier: someone technical enough to earn the trust of our strongest architects, strategic enough to shape the direction of the business, customer-focused enough to command a C-suite conversation, and collaborative enough to make the organizations around them more successful.

Most importantly, we want a leader who does not wait for the future to arrive. They help define it.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Description

Directs teams to conduct thorough market research and analysis across diverse product portfolios, ensuring alignment with Oracle's strategic goals and continuously refining competitive strategies to lead in the marketplace. Directs teams in identifying and capitalizing on customer needs, market opportunities, and regulatory requirements. Champions internal teams in the development of problem statements and solutions. Guides the product lifecycle from planning to release and establishes long-term initiatives for evolving the product roadmap for an extensive portfolio of products/features. Establishes innovative best practices organization-wide and champions analytic framework for data-driven decision-making. Partners with key stakeholders at the executive level to define and drive product direction. Drives alignment across Lines of Business (LOB) to drive product innovation and evolution. Establishes success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs and KPIs) for multiple products and features. Provides strategic oversight to teams in customer advocacy and customer-centric approaches throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring that products are tailored to customer needs. Guides the resolution development process for complex and/or high-stakes customer issues. Guides and strategically coordinates the delivery for the field team and governs various go-to-market efforts, such as recruiting and supporting early adopters to validate and refine product solutions, developing user documentation, and product demonstrations.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Directs teams to conduct market research and analysis, enabling the organization to evaluate data patterns across diverse portfolios and prioritize initiatives with the highest strategic impact.

–Guides teams to ensure that the product portfolio aligns with Oracle's strategic objectives, continuously refining competitive strategies to lead in the marketplace.

–Governs alignment efforts that integrate customer feedback, market trends, internal stakeholder priorities, and Oracle’s long-term goals.

–Sets strategic direction for product positioning, pricing, and market strategy, ensuring Oracle's sustained leadership and innovation in the industry.

Product Analysis – Solution Identification:

–Directs teams identifying and capitalizing on customers' unmet needs, market opportunities, and/or regulatory requirements, shaping the organization's strategic direction and product portfolio.

–Champions internal teams in developing problem statements and forming hypotheses for new products, ensuring alignment with long-term customer needs, emerging market trends, and organizational goals.

–Guides solution identification processes, providing strategic oversight as needed.

–Governs the creation and maintenance of solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory requirements, functional and non-functional requirements, user documentation), offering guidance as necessary.

–Guides the planning, execution, and release processes for the organization’s entire product lifecycle, ensuring alignment with the overall strategic vision.

–Advises others in establishing and developing feature requirements and resources, setting innovative best practices organization-wide.

–Collaborates with senior executive stakeholders to drive delivery excellence, maintain project timelines, and ensure success.

–Champions analytic frameworks for existing metrics (e.g., Service Requests, bugs, customer feedback, customer volumes) and data-driven decision-making to achieve optimal product development and market impact.

–Provides strategic oversight for the development and review of user stories and acceptance criteria, ensuring unparalleled product quality and customer satisfaction.

–Forecasts future needs and guides prioritization of features or experiences in the roadmap, aligning them with ambitious success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:

–Partners with key stakeholders at the executive level to drive product direction in alignment with the company's vision, business goals, and customer needs.

–Guides business performance and operations reviews to track progress and identify opportunities for improvement.

–Strategizes the innovation and evolution of products through identification and prioritization of new features and enhancements.

Alignment and Collaboration:

–Drives alignment across business units, ensuring strategic insights are shared effectively and communication channels are optimized at all levels.

–Establishes success criteria and performance metrics (OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products and features, ensuring alignment with the organization’s strategic vision.

Customer-Centricity:

–Provides strategic oversight to teams advocating for customers, ensuring feedback is a critical part of the product lifecycle and overall business strategy.

–Empowers employees to engage effectively with customers, gather actionable feedback, and utilize analytics to inform strategic decision-making and improve Oracle’s offerings.

–Leads teams in adopting a customer-centric approach to identify, prioritize, and execute enhancements that provide transformative business value.

–Forecasts new product capabilities and feature designs, leveraging deep customer insights and market trends.

–Champions alignment between products and customer needs, leading initiatives to continuously adapt to, and anticipate, market shifts.

–Coordinates cross-functional collaboration, maximizing product consumer satisfaction and product success.

–Provides oversight on resolving complex and high-stakes customer issues, ensuring customer satisfaction and product quality.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Guides the review, validation, and strategic coordination of delivery for the field team (e.g., release overview, field presentations, demos).

–Directs development of user documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment across the organization.

–Performs high-level review of the product adoption tracking process, ensuring improvement initiatives align with long-term strategic goals.

–Guides product demonstrations for customers, partners, industry analysts, and field, engaging key stakeholders to gather feedback.

Planning & Execution:

–Provides strategic oversight in managing and executing large-scale projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets to ensure success.

–Sets strategies for delegation, priority setting, and aligning projects with business needs.

–Drives the strategic planning process across teams, providing guidance on resource allocation and anticipating changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Sets strategic direction for collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of expectations and objectives.

–Drives a culture of teamwork, empowering teams to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and customers for organizational success.

–Promotes transparency and inclusivity so that all voices are valued and respected.

Problem Solving:

–Develops and implements organizational strategies for advanced problem-solving, serving as an escalation point for highly complex operational or technical issues.

–Oversees teams leveraging innovative techniques to tackle ambiguous issues and identifies root causes to prevent recurrence, reviewing solutions as needed.

Continuous Learning:

–Champions continuous learning to maintain cutting-edge skills and organizational best practices.

–Inspires teams to maintain expertise by monitoring trends, technologies, and standards, positioning Oracle as an industry leader.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms - Yahoo Mail
jobs.description:
Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever.

About The Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms
for Yahoo Mail,
to lead the product strategy and execution for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared technology integrations. This role owns the horizontal capabilities that power Yahoo Mail experiences across all platforms, including authentication, identity, privacy, security, and foundational client frameworks.

This is a senior, highly cross-functional role that works deeply with application engineering teams, experience-focused product managers, and central platform and infrastructure teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that Yahoo Mail clients remain secure, compliant, scalable, and adaptable as the product ecosystem evolves.

A critical dimension of this role is guiding Yahoo Mail through large-scale platform transitions and service realignments, ensuring continuity for users and partners while enabling independent execution across multiple organizations. This work requires strong systems thinking, excellent stakeholder management, and comfort operating in complex commercial and technical environments.

What You’ll Do

Own the product vision and roadmap for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared services across web, iOS, Android, and emerging surfaces.
Define and shape the strategic roadmaps for Yahoo Mail client platforms, including decisions around codebases, architectural patterns, and technology investments that enable long-term scalability and maintainability.
Partner closely with application engineering teams to ensure client platforms are built and operated in a cost-efficient manner, balancing performance, developer velocity, and operational complexity.
Drive adoption of modern technologies and platform capabilities to deliver fast, reliable, and secure user experiences across all clients.
Partner with AI and platform teams to enable client-side support for AI-powered experiences, ensuring Yahoo Mail clients can securely and efficiently integrate capabilities such as intelligent assistance, personalization, and emerging AI-driven features.
Lead cross-platform initiatives spanning authentication, identity, privacy, security, and compliance, in close collaboration with central platform teams.
Act as the connective tissue between client engineering, experience-focused product managers, and backend platform teams, ensuring cohesive end-to-end execution.
Drive platform consistency while enabling differentiated experiences across clients where appropriate.
Lead complex platform transitions, service separations, and long-running partner support programs that require coordination across multiple teams, organizations, and external stakeholders.
Ensure client platforms are resilient to organizational change, capable of operating independently where required, and aligned with long-term commercial, legal, and regulatory constraints.
Represent Yahoo Mail in executive-level discussions related to platform strategy, technical risk, timelines, and tradeoffs.
Define and track success metrics across performance, security posture, reliability, cost efficiency, and developer productivity, using data to guide prioritization and investment decisions.

What We’re Looking For

Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of platforms, infrastructure-adjacent products, or large-scale client systems. Experience building and operating consumer applications at scale is strongly preferred. Direct experience with email platforms or messaging systems is a strong plus, given the unique technical, operational, and trust challenges of email.
Application Platform Leadership: Proven ability to define and evolve shared capabilities used by many teams, balancing consistency with flexibility while keeping end users and business customers connected through reliable, scalable platforms.
Technical Depth: Strong technical fluency across client architectures, authentication and identity systems, privacy and security controls, and platform integrations. Familiarity with the complexity and constraints of email ecosystems (deliverability, trust, abuse prevention, identity, and standards) is highly valued.
Complex Program Ownership: Demonstrated success leading ambiguous, multi-year initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, external dependencies, and contractual considerations, while maintaining operational stability and user trust.
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to align engineering, legal, privacy, security, commercial, and executive stakeholders around a common plan, particularly in environments where platforms serve both consumers and enterprise partners.
Product Judgment: Strong instincts for risk management, sequencing, and tradeoffs in high-impact, high-visibility environments, with a focus on protecting user trust and long-term platform health.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical, organizational, and platform concepts to senior audiences.
Mission & Product Mindset: A genuine interest in building products that empower people in their day-to-day lives, with an appreciation for email as a vital, enduring communications tool that continues to have real-world impact at a global scale

Your Day-to-Day

Partner with client and platform engineering leaders to translate strategic goals into executable roadmaps.
Collaborate with experienced product managers to ensure platform capabilities enable high-quality user experiences across all clients.
Work closely with identity, authentication, privacy, and security teams to ensure compliant and secure implementations.
Lead planning and execution for major platform changes, transitions, and long-term initiatives.
Identify risks early, drive alignment on mitigation strategies, and keep senior leadership informed.
Serve as a trusted product leader for some of the most complex and foundational work within Yahoo Mail.

The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity.

Frame.io is redefining how creative work happens. Creative professionals around the world, from independent filmmakers to teams at large brands, rely on Frame.io to seamlessly collaborate and bring their stories to life.

Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Product Manager to drive go-to-market execution and strengthen cross-product alignment. You’ll bring together Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Insights, and other channel teams around a shared campaign strategy and ensure that every part of the campaign works together to maximize its impact.

You’ll propose how an idea should come to life across channels, identify the moments and tactics that can make it bigger, establish the campaign plan and operating cadence, and drive alignment among the cross-functional team and prioritize exceptional execution.

At Ro, Directors are both leaders and operators. This role will initially be an individual contributor, but will have significant cross-functional leadership responsibility. You should be equally comfortable shaping the strategy for a major campaign and getting into the details required to make it successful.

What You’ll Do

Lead Ro's highest-priority integrated campaigns

Own the integrated marketing strategy and execution for major consumer campaigns, including celebrity partnerships, brand moments, and other high-priority launches.
Translate campaign objectives, audience insights, product claims, and an aligned creative concept into a clear integrated marketing strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels.
Identify opportunities to maximize a creative concept across channels, ensuring we're not simply adapting the same idea everywhere but taking advantage of what each channel can uniquely contribute.
Build the campaign architecture: define the role of each channel, key moments, sequencing, dependencies, and how the pieces work together to create greater impact.
Maintain a holistic view of the consumer experience and ensure campaigns feel cohesive wherever consumers encounter Ro.

Orchestrate cross-functional teams

Serve as the single accountable marketing lead for assigned integrated campaigns, bringing together teams across Brand, Product Marketing, Growth,Communications, and other functions.
Partner with Product Marketing to understand the consumer insight, value proposition, and product claims we can credibly bring to market.
Partner closely with Brand as they develop the creative concept, helping pressure-test how ideas can extend across channels and identifying opportunities to maximize the concept once aligned.
Partner with channel owners to determine how the campaign should come to life within their channels, bringing their expertise into the integrated strategy rather than prescribing channel execution.
Create clarity across complex initiatives by establishing priorities, roles, decision points, dependencies, timelines, and operating rhythms.
Anticipate risks and resolve cross-functional blockers before they compromise the quality or timing of a launch.

Raise the bar for integrated marketing at Ro

Develop a repeatable approach to integrated campaign planning that enables teams to move quickly without sacrificing strategic rigor or executional excellence.
Push teams to think beyond individual channel deliverables and identify opportunities for ideas to build on one another across the entire campaign.
Bring a strong point of view on what makes integrated consumer marketing effective and help evolve how Ro shows up during our biggest marketing moments.
Create strong feedback loops after launches, partnering with channel teams to understand performance and translating those learnings into better future campaigns.

Be a hands-on leader

Personally drive the work required to move campaigns from strategy through execution rather than relying on a large team to do it for you.
Move fluidly between strategic thinking and executional detail—from determining how a campaign should show up across the consumer journey to resolving an issue that could put a launch at risk.
Lead through influence, building trust and alignment across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.
Operate comfortably in ambiguity and bring structure and momentum to complex, fast-moving initiatives.

Experience operating in a lean, fast-moving organization where senior leaders are expected to both set direction and execute.
Low ego and high ownership. No part of getting an important campaign successfully into market is beneath you.

In your first year, you'll have established yourself as the person Ro turns to when we need to bring a major marketing moment to market exceptionally well.

Our highest-priority campaigns will have a clear integrated strategy, stronger coordination across teams and channels, and a cohesive consumer experience from first exposure through conversion and beyond. This technical product manager will lead with curiosity and a builder's mindset, working collaboratively to translate complex physical environments into intuitive digital experiences. They will dive deep into the systems, sensors, and data that underpin GREF's real estate portfolio and develop a keen understanding of how real time information can drive smarter facility decisions. In short

At On, our ambition is bold: to become the most premium global sports brand, built on performance, design, and sustainability. We are driven by a singular mission — to ignite the human spirit through movement. We are looking for a visionary and hands-on leader to join us as Head of Digital Product for China, a strategic, consumer-centric leadership position with end-to-end accountability for shaping the full digital product and consumer experience for millions of customers in China. This covers the entire omni-channel journey — from online/offline integration to key local platforms like WeChat Miniprogram and China Digital Marketplaces. You will serve as the center of consumer, digital experience, technology, and project management, defining the product vision and roadmap, and co-owning execution with Engineering and Commercial leadership to build data-driven, personalized experiences that attract, convert, and retain customers.

Your mission

Your mission is to shape and articulate a compelling product vision and long-term strategy for On’s omni-channel digital consumer experiences in China. You will serve as the center of consumer, digital experience, technology, and project management, owning how our products attract, engage, and retain customers across all commercial channels — Retail, Wholesale, Local DTC (WeChat), and China Marketplaces — ensuring experiences are premium, locally relevant, and globally scalable. As the strategic owner of the China customer product portfolio, you will define how data, personalization, and seamless cross-channel journeys come together to drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and commercial growth. You will guide the evolution and integration of both global platforms and locally built capabilities, ensuring a seamless, end-to-end customer journey across offline and online touchpoints, with a core focus on WeChat Miniprogram and China Digital Marketplaces. A core part of your mission is to elevate Digital Product in China to a true strategic partnership — deeply understanding customer and business needs, shaping direction early, and co-owning outcomes with Technology and Commercial leadership. You will serve as a key connector between China and the global organization, turning local insights into global advantage and helping build a world-class, interconnected digital experience that fuels On’s growth in China and beyond. Define Product Vision & Strategy: Shape and articulate a compelling product vision and long-term strategy for customer experiences in China, aligned with On’s global brand, commercial goals, and technology strategy. Translate complex market dynamics, customer insights, and business priorities into clear product principles and actionable roadmaps. Lead Omni-Channel Customer Experiences Own the end-to-end product experience across Retail, Wholesale, Local DTC (WeChat), and China Marketplaces. Ensure a connected, cohesive, premium, and locally relevant experience across all touchpoints while enabling global scalability. Drive Roadmap Ownership & Execution Lead the development, prioritization, and execution of product roadmaps, balancing speed, quality, and long-term value together with your tech counterpart. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Commercial leaders to ensure high-quality, predictable delivery of strategic initiatives. Champion Customer & Market Insights Promote a deep understanding of Chinese customer behaviors, expectations, and journeys, ensuring insights are consistently reflected in product decisions. Embed customer discovery, research, and validation into how teams work. Inspire & Develop High-Performing Teams Build, mentor, and empower a high-performing product organization in China. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and outcome-driven thinking, enabling teams to do their best work. Foster Innovation & Continuous Improvement Encourage experimentation and learning to evolve customer experiences, personalization, and engagement models. Partner with Tech and Data leaders to leverage modern technologies and AI-driven capabilities where they create meaningful customer and business impact. Leverage Data for Growth & Impact Establish a data-driven decision-making culture, defining success metrics tied to customer engagement, retention, and commercial performance. Use insights and experimentation to guide prioritization, justify investments, and continuously improve outcomes. Act as the China Product Voice Globally Represent China’s product needs and opportunities within the global organization. Share learnings and innovations from China to help influence global product strategy and platform evolution.

Your story

Proven Product Leadership: You bring 10+ years of experience in Product Management, including senior leadership roles where you’ve led teams delivering complex, customer-facing products at scale. You have a strong track record of owning outcomes across strategy, execution, and impact. Strategic & Customer-Centric Mindset: You possess a sharp strategic mindset and the ability to translate complex business and customer challenges into clear, actionable product visions and roadmaps. You naturally connect customer needs, business objectives, and product strategy, and you know how to make trade-offs that drive long-term value. Deep Understanding of the China Digital Ecosystem: You have strong experience operating in the China digital landscape, with a solid understanding of local customer behaviors, platforms, and expectations. You are comfortable working across DTC ecosystems (e.g. WeChat), retail, wholesale, and marketplaces, and know how to tailor experiences for local relevance while contributing to global scale. Strong Product & Technical Acumen: You have a solid grasp of modern digital product technologies and data-driven product development. You collaborate effectively with Engineering and Data leaders, confidently engaging in discussions around architecture, feasibility, scalability, and quality, ensuring product ambition is matched by strong execution. Inspirational People Leader: You are a people-first leader with a passion for building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product teams. You set a high bar, create clarity, and foster an environment of trust, ownership, and continuous learning. Exceptional Communicator & Influencer: You are a clear, compelling communicator who can articulate product strategy and complex ideas to diverse audiences — from engineering teams to senior executives. You are skilled at navigating complex stakeholder environments, building alignment, and influencing decisions across regions and functions. Global Mindset, Local Impact: You have experience working in global organizations, partnering across cultures and time zones. You are comfortable representing local needs on a global stage — and translating global strategy into meaningful, impactful execution in China. Fluent in English and Mandarin: You are able to operate confidently in cross-cultural environments.

Meet the team

You will be part of the Digital and Consumer, China organization, with extended collaboration and partnership with the global and China Commercial, Digital and Tech organizations. Working in close partnership with Commercial, Engineering, Data, and business leaders across China and APAC, you will shape and execute a cohesive product vision that enables scale, transparency, and organizational agility.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate.
